attempts.summary: On node1 (AlmaLinux 9), installed the dnf versionlock plugin and locked curl at its currently installed version (curl-7.76.1-31.el9). Verified the hold by running a real `dnf update -y` that upgraded 224 packages including a new kernel and libcurl (7.76.1-40.el9_8.5) while curl itself stayed pinned at 7.76.1-31.el9. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued `systemctl reboot`, confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual restart, now running kernel 5.14.0-687.42.1), and confirmed the system returned to healthy state (systemctl is-system-running: running, 0 failed units) with the curl versionlock rule and pinned version intact post-reboot.
